source.book: Numerology With Tantra, Ayurveda, and Astrology: A Key to Human Behavior
source.author: Harish Johari

introduction: Rules people born on day 6, 15, or 24, or whose destiny/name number totals 6.
Venus, the "morning star," is the most radiant planet in the eastern sky, visible to the naked eye twice — before sunrise and after sunset.

A benefic planet with a feminine, watery nature. In mythology has two images: a fair, curly-haired youth embodying love and sensuality, an outgoing hedonist; and a white-bearded teacher (acharya) of the antigods (asuras).

Known as Shukra ("semen" in Sanskrit), presiding deity of the sensuous side of human nature; governs refined attributes — romance, beauty, passion, sexual pleasure, and fine arts like music, poetry, dance — as well as the eyes, throat, chin, kidney, and reproductive system.

Rajastic (active); gives an active, artistic, sensuous, passionate nature; bestows beauty, proportionate/attractive bodies (especially upper torso and arms), lotus-like eyes, fair complexion, and a happy, graceful personality — lively, emotional, sensitive, playful, loving, courteous, frivolous, polite; creative, inventive, interested in medicine, alchemy, Tantra, hypnotism, mesmerism, and the fine arts.
Governs the adolescent stage of life; its influence differs slightly between women and men.
Friend of Mercury and Saturn; Jupiter and Mars are neutral toward it (though Venus regards Jupiter as an opponent); Sun and Moon are its enemies.
Number 6 is regarded as the most fortunate of all numbers 1-9. Those born on the 24th of any month are the most fortunate 6s.

psychicNumber: Psychic number of those born on day 6, 15, or 24. Magnetic, youthful, gentle, soft-spoken, luxury-loving, artistic, refined taste; attract and are loved/respected by the opposite sex easily.
Spend freely, social, meet beautiful people; love travel, often journey to foreign lands; always busy.
Overly conscious of physical appearance, always dress presentably.
Dislike ugliness, dirtiness, mismanagement, disorder; keep dwellings clean and orderly and love decorating homes, rooms, offices, workplaces.
Devoted to their life partner under all circumstances, try to please them; married life is ordinary but orderly.
Dislike disturbed environments, don't initiate arguments; if someone starts a fight, they withdraw and stay ready for compromise.

Clever and tactful, learn others' guarded secrets without deliberate effort; think before acting (gives them a slow tempo, but they believe "slow and steady wins the race"); upset when forced to move quickly (spoils their work); dislike interference once work has begun or being crossed; not commanding/demanding but hide anger under attractive smiles.
Secretive by nature, keep others' secrets well.

Universal friends, good family members; considerate/kind to family, understand kin's joys and sorrows; maintain ties with parents after leaving home and try hard to ease their parents' sorrow; trust friends and family.
Popular in their circle thanks to refined taste, sweet manners, considerate/gentle nature — become everybody's favorite; extravagant.
Lucky enough to acquire modern luxuries (house with garden, vehicles) before age 45.
Love company, cannot live alone for long. Notable difference between number-6 men and number-6 women.

Number-6 men: youthful, attractive, magnetic, expert in lovemaking, skilled at attracting/seducing women; seek beautiful women throughout life, enjoy their company but rarely stay bound to whoever they marry; hedonistic, materialistic, anti-discipline, incapable of sustained spiritual practice (occasionally religious, mostly not); susceptible to venereal and seminal diseases.

Number-6 women: physically beautiful, symmetrical, refined taste; their love is motherly in nature. Mischievous, playful, sensual in adolescence; drawn to sexual games until around 25, then tire of them and turn toward career and a calmer, happier life. Usually slow and quite temperamental; fond of dresses/jewelry, design their own gowns, live comfortably; drawn to learned, artistic, spiritually inclined people; serve family and parents, love justice and truth, dependable, don't run from responsibility; can seduce holy men.
Both men and women of this number have few real friends and often live alone at points in life, though they love their homes; uncommitted, love freedom/simplicity/serenity, not selfish.
Unsteady, cannot concentrate on one subject for long.
Very lucky — get help and guidance throughout life from unknown sources, foreigners, and people in authority.
precautions: Avoid laziness; don't become easily agitated.
Overcome nervousness with mukta pishti (pearl powder) or prawal pishti (coral powder), a teaspoon with cream or honey before retiring.
Learn to judge people thoroughly before trusting them — women especially, before entering physical or financial relationships.
Avoid arguments; don't waste energy explaining their behavior or ideas.
Work slowly (their best mode); avoid rushing, which spoils projects.
Avoid getting emotional or giving undue importance to the opposite sex.
Avoid hard physical labor — their constitution isn't suited to it.
Forgive those who wrong them; don't waste energy on revenge — bearing grudges/brooding over the past harms their nervous system.
Avoid sweet dishes, oils and fats, and spicy foods.
Practice pranayama (breath control from Hatha Yoga), take regular morning walks, and massage the body 3-4 times a week.
Organize their schedules and lives; don't spend excessive time on watersports/amusement.
destinyNumber: Not a good destiny number, especially for women — creates many sexual problems for which the individual isn't really responsible, pushing them into unwanted sexual relationships (as a psychic number this inclination is in the psyche and more acceptable, but as destiny it happens almost involuntarily, as if by fate).
Get all comforts and luxuries through luck; have all they want, but struggle to find a suitable life partner if they don't marry young.
Care for friends/relations tirelessly, working hard all their lives to do so; become very independent yet remain social.
Good conversationalists and storytellers; travel a lot, enjoy life, love good tasty food.
More sentimental than logical, tend to brood over the past.
Don't accept bondage, uncommitted, break laws, avoid traditional religions; drawn to secret sciences — alchemy, Tantra (especially left-handed Tantra), witchcraft, black magic.
Dependable, peace-loving, romantic, methodical workers who can serve as good diplomats and protect the interests of their own class.
Money slips through their hands — generous, spend lavishly entertaining relatives and friends.
Fond of collecting beautiful dresses, perfumes, cosmetics, jewelry, and precious stones.
Remain attractive, charming, youthful into old age — women especially keep their glamour a long time.
Suffer from overwork and sexual overindulgence; prone to venereal disease.
nameNumber: Best suited as a name number for poets, artists, musicians, and dancers — gives a friendly quality that makes 6s acceptable and popular.
Also good for those drawn to the occult sciences, who can gain magical powers with it.
Makes people cooperative, kind, sympathetic, hospitable, charitable, emotional, and unstable; sociable, fond of idle gossip; easily attracted to beauty, internal and external, in people and nature.
weakPeriods: April, October, and November are weak periods.

Whenever Venus is retrograde, health problems, bad news, and mental obstacles at work can arise; loss of courage, inspiration, steadiness, and patience; can become proud, discourteous, obstinate, argumentative, jealous, indecisive; lose common sense and trust everyone, becoming emotionally upset when deceived.
strongPeriods: April 20 - May 18, and September 21 - October 19 (especially strong: April 20-30 and October 1-19).
Good for new jobs, new contracts, house-hunting if needed, finishing incomplete jobs, and taking actions that help future work.
sections.goodDates: Days 6, 15, and 24 of every month are favorable; days 3, 9, 12, 18, 21, 27, and 30 are also beneficial.
sections.goodDays: Wednesdays and Fridays; extra beneficial if falling on one of the above good dates.
sections.favorableColors: White is best (Venus's color). Light blue, pink, and chrome yellow are also good (yellow is linked to Jupiter, and since Venus is exalted in Pisces — a Jupiter-ruled sign — yellow enhances 6s' good qualities). Number-6 women should use a lot of pink and wear white on important occasions for success. For interior decor, use as much white as possible (bedsheets, pillow covers); always carry a white handkerchief for tired or weak moments.
preciousStones: Diamond is the favored stone (associated with Venus); if unaffordable, use white sapphire, white zircon, or white tourmaline.
Bought on a Friday between sunrise and 11 a.m.; given to the jeweler on a Friday to be set in an open-back ring; picked up and worn (after cleansing/rituals) on a Friday between sunrise and 11 a.m.
White tourmaline powder taken to help the body heal electrochemically.
sections.meditation: After morning cleansing, meditate on a diamond or its substitute stone.
sections.deity: Kartike (also known as Skandha and Subramaniyam), elder son of Shiva and God of war — six heads, four arms, rides a peacock.

mantra.text: AUM—JUNG, HANG, SA, BHUR, BHUVAN, SWA, KARTIKE NAMAH, SWA, BHUVAH BHUR, SA, HANG, JUNG—AUM
mantra.repetitions: Though difficult for 6s to keep spiritual disciplines, reciting this mantra eleven times a day is beneficial.

yantra.description: Yantra of Venus — 3x3 numerical magic square (kamea)

healthAndDiseases: Mucus-dominated constitution — prone to lung problems such as congestion.
Extremely sensual — susceptible to exhaustion from overindulgence, seminal troubles, or venereal disease; can also develop kidney and urinary problems.
Fondness for sweets and spicy/oily food can cause constipation.
sections.fasting: Fast on Fridays; abstain from grains, pulses, and sour foods on Fridays after sunset.
sections.friendship: In harmony with 1s, 3s, 9s, and other 6s; can also get along with 2s, 5s, and 7s. Fours and 8s are not harmonious. Ones and 3s make ideal friends.
romance: A number-6 woman should choose a psychic 1, 3, or 6 for romance, and a psychic 3 or 6 for marriage.

specialNote: Age 35 is of great importance for 6s — they start building a bright career in early life and are well-established by 35. By 49, they reach their maximum material potential and often hold positions of high responsibility.

relationships.1: In general, 6s and 1s are friendly, and 6s have a good influence on 1s — though 6s puzzle 1s, 6s understand and can help/influence 1s clearly. Sixes can serve as 1s' business partners, though the relationship tends not to last long unless they avoid staying together constantly; it works better meeting briefly to work, travel, and organize events together, with 6s accepting 1s' authority. Breakdown by gender: 6-men and 1-men become friends easily and can benefit each other in politics, though 6-men (who enjoy life) can't fully appreciate idealistic 1s, so the friendship doesn't last — not ideal but not harmful for business. 6-women and 1-men: 1-men prove beneficial/helpful to 6-women though not ideal life or business partners; 6-women make ideal secretaries for 1-men. 6-men and 1-women: 6-men's marital promiscuity clashes with 1-women's desire for honesty and true relationships, so they aren't good life partners; in business, 1-women don't trust 6-men with money and prefer to keep the upper hand. 6-women and 1-women: become very good friends who try to please each other — 6's slow tempo gives overbusy 1 a breather, and the 1-woman maintains the friendship with precious gifts.
relationships.2: Can be good friends — 6s help 2s' growth and development, providing peaceful vibrations and good advice, though not inspiration for work. In friendship, 2s are less helpful to 6s than 6s are to 2s, so 6 should avoid depending on 2 for important jobs. In business, 2s are more beneficial to 6s. Not suitable for marriage, for either 6-men or 6-women.
relationships.3: Harmonious. Choosing 3s brings favorable results for 6s in friendship, business partnership, or life partnership — they help each other. Doesn't work as well in the married life of 6-men, since a 3-woman can't tolerate her husband having relationships outside the marriage; 6-men should avoid marrying 3-women, though the reverse (6-woman/3-man) is excellent. Sixes should select the number 3 for appointment dates or residential numbers.
relationships.4: Harmonious as numbers, but don't work too well together in practice — 4s upset and create difficulties for 6s, yet 6s are easily attracted to them anyway; 4s resist learning from or being taught by 6s. Sixes (women especially) should avoid 4s for marriage, business partnership, appointment dates, and residential numbers.
relationships.5: Mutual friends. Fives help 6s with psychological problems and can be good therapists/physicians for them; 5s positively influence 6s' physical and mental health, while 6s help 5s overcome their restless, ever-changing mind. Their friendship can reach unusual heights in politics and the communication arts (TV, film, journalism). Marriage between a 6-woman and 5-man is not ideal, but the reverse (5-woman/6-man) is very good. Sixes can enter business partnerships with 5s and use number 5 for important business appointments or residential numbers.
relationships.6: Two 6s are friends, but being on the same frequency they don't inspire each other, though they feel great satisfaction together and understand each other very well — they need a 1, 3, 5, or 9 native to provide inspiration. In businesses like cosmetics, fashion design, interior design, or jewelry, two 6s work very tastefully together as good partners. Marriage isn't ideal since they can't inspire each other, though they make a good family together. Sixes should select 6 for appointment dates and residential numbers.
relationships.7: Sixes always help and inspire 7s, but not the reverse — 6s help 7s develop their dreamy nature (7 represents fantasy/intuition, 6 is worldly). Sevens express known truths in original but unclear ways, which mildly annoys clarity-loving 6s. Sixes can enjoy 7s' company during leisure but should stay away from 7's fantasies during serious business, and should avoid 7 for appointment dates or residential numbers — not a good couple in general, though marriage can work when the 7 is a man and the 6 a woman.
relationships.8: Sixes are always beneficial to 8s — 6s inspire 8s and make them more social and lighter (8s are otherwise heavy and silent); 6's playfulness gives 8s a taste for life's luxuries and comforts, and 8s become more creative and expressive through 6s. If both are in politics, art, or film, they achieve success together. In business, 6s shouldn't invest in ventures started by 8s, though 8s can join 6-led business and gain financially. Marriage: 8s are not good for 6s generally, though if necessary a 6-woman could marry an 8-man and enjoy a few good years. Sixes should avoid 8 for appointment dates and residential numbers.
relationships.9: These numbers always benefit each other — both multiples of 3, forming a good combination. Mutually beneficial in friendship and business: 6s carefully guard 9s' interests, while 9s do the hard work for the joint venture. In music and fine arts, 6 and 9 make a very good combination. In politics, a 6 can be an admirer, follower, PR person, and systematic planner for a 9. Makes a good, loving couple, ideally with the 9 as the man and 6 as the woman. Sixes should select 9 for appointment dates and residential numbers.
